walkthroughs.body_html:
In 1928 Alexander Fleming noticed Penicillium mould killing bacteria on a Petri dish.

He couldn't make enough to test on humans. In 1941 Florey and Chain mass-produced it. US factories made tonnes by D-Day in 1944, saving thousands of Allied soldiers.

The 1942 Beveridge Report attacked five giants: want, disease, ignorance, squalor and idleness.

After Labour's 1945 win, Aneurin Bevan launched the NHS on 5 July 1948 — free at the point of use, paid for by taxes. It was the world's first fully nationalised health service.

In 1909 Ehrlich's Salvarsan 606 was the first 'magic bullet' drug, targeting syphilis.

Later came DNA discovery in 1953, keyhole surgery and the 2003 Human Genome Project. Lifestyle diseases like cancer and heart disease became the new battlefront.

mcqs.q: Why was the founding of the NHS controversial in 1948?
options: The British Medical Association opposed nationalisation of doctors; Bevan made concessions allowing private practice; Conservatives feared cost and central control.
The NHS was originally only for soldiers returning from WWII.
The NHS was founded in 1918 after the influenza pandemic.
The NHS was supported by all parties and all doctors from the start.

mcqs.q: Why was the NHS founded in 1948?
options: Beveridge's 1942 report identified disease as a 'giant evil'; Labour's 1945 manifesto promised universal healthcare; Bevan unified hospitals and made care free at point of use.
Cities were unhealthy because factory smoke poisoned the food.
The NHS was founded in 1918 after the influenza pandemic.
The NHS was founded because Churchill wanted to thank soldiers after WWII.

mcqs.q: Why were 19th-century industrial cities so unhealthy?
options: Cities were unhealthy because Victorians did not care about hygiene.
The NHS was founded in 1918 after the influenza pandemic.
Cities were unhealthy because factory smoke poisoned the food.
Rapid population growth outpaced housing, water and sewage; lack of regulation produced overcrowded slums and cholera epidemics until reforms followed Chadwick's 1842 report.
